description: One call for a day and the night before it: sleep, recovery, activity and workouts, each fetched independently (a failed section is null and explained in errors). sleep is the night that led INTO date (main = longest non-nap sleep, durations in seconds; sleeps under about 3 h are naps, so a short night has main null). recovery covers the local day (low is its lowest balance, not necessarily overnight; atBedtime is the sample nearest the main sleep's start, which falls on the previous local day, null without a main sleep or a sample within an hour). energyKcal looks like ACTIVE energy (unverified). A value is null, never 0, when Suunto has no sample. With `to`: { from, to, days, errors }. Use instead of combining get_sleep, get_recovery, get_daily_activity_statistics and list_workouts.

date.description: Local day YYYY-MM-DD (first day with `to`). Today is partial until the watch syncs.

to.description: Optional last day (inclusive, at most 14 days after `date`); one request per section for the range.

name: get_daily_snapshot
title: Get daily snapshot
